search_conclusion: For the stock Sidewinder roller secondary, the lowest pre-programmed Dalton angle found is the 28 degree segment of YSR36/28; the lowest straight listed option is YSR31. STM offers custom cuts, but those are not a stocked OTS angle and are not used as the paper anchor.
